entities.name: Antoine-Éléonor-Léon Leclerc de Juigné
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Antoine-Éléonor-Léon Leclerc de Juigné was a French Catholic prelate and politician who served as Archbishop of Paris from 1782 to 1802. He was elected deputy of the clergy to the Estates General of 1789.
